title: InfraWerf plugin manifest (API v2)
description: The contents of `infrawerf-plugin.json` for plugin API v2.

api_version.description: The InfraWerf plugin API version the plugin was written for.

author.description: Author or maintainer, 80 characters at most.

capabilities.description:
Every capability the plugin asks the owner for. Each must be used by
at least one contribution.

contributions.description: What the plugin adds, between 1 and 64 entries.

homepage.description:
An `https://` address for the plugin, 200 characters at most.
InfraWerf shows it and never fetches it.

id.description:
Reverse-domain identifier, for example `org.example.backup-overview`:
at least three lower-case segments of letters, digits and hyphens,
each starting with a letter, 63 characters at most. It never changes
between versions of the same plugin.

license.description: Licence, preferably an SPDX identifier, 64 characters at most.

version.description: The plugin's own version, as Semantic Versioning 2.0.0.

Capability.description:
What a contribution may use. A contribution must declare every capability
it relies on; `ExtensionRegistry::authorize` refuses anything undeclared.

oneOf.description: Read the saved map, approved inventory and activity on this PC.
Change map entries on this PC. Never changes a server.
Unauthenticated TCP/HTTP reachability checks.
Verify and use the owner's existing OpenSSH access.
Run a fixed, approved read-only command in an authenticated session.
Read remote files and metadata over SFTP.
Create, rename, move or delete remote files after confirmation.
Upload and download between this PC and a server.
The owner's interactive terminal in an authenticated session.
Ask for sudo for one named action.
Start, stop or restart a discovered workload after confirmation.
Open a loopback-only SSH forward to a server's own localhost.
A tab in a server's workspace.
A badge on a server's card on the map.
A section of a server's Settings tab (settings about one server).
A section of the application-wide Settings screen.
An entry in the main menu that opens one application view.
Collects approved inventory from a server.
An unauthenticated reachability check.
A brokered operation on a server.

A named application in a server's Apps list, opened through the
same loopback tunnel as any other (plugin API v2).

A named kind of relationship for the map: a label and a line style.
It documents intent and applies nothing (plugin API v2).

Extractor.description: How a command's output becomes a value or a table.

oneOf.description: One line of the output as a single value.

line.description: Which line, counting from 1. Defaults to 1; 1000 at most.

oneOf.description: Each line as a row of named columns. At most 100 rows are kept.

columns.description:
1 to 12 column names: lower-case letters, digits and
underscores, starting with a letter. The last column takes the
rest of the line.

skip_lines.description: Lines to skip before the first row, 100 at most. Defaults to 0.

oneOf.description: One text, number or true/false value from JSON output.

path.description:
Dotted names with optional `[index]`, for example
`pool.disks[0].state`; 200 characters at most.

KindColor.description: The colour of a relationship kind, from a fixed set.

oneOf.description: The colour of a plain relationship.
Blue.
Amber.
Red.
Purple.
Grey.

LineStyle.description: The line of a relationship kind.

oneOf.description: An unbroken line.
A line of dashes.
A line of dots.

ManifestContribution.description: One thing a plugin adds at an extension point.

app.description: Required for a `remote_app`: the application to open (API v2).

badge.description: For a `server_badge`: the pack observation the badge shows (API v2).

capabilities.description:
The capabilities this contribution uses: at least one, each
requested by the manifest and permitted at this extension point.

command.description:
A read-only command this contribution runs, for a `collector` or a
`health_check` (API v2). It needs `ssh_session` and
`run_approved_command`.

id.description:
Name within the plugin: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens,
starting with a letter, 32 characters at most. The full identifier
is the plugin ID, a dot, then this.

order.description:
Position among contributions at the same point. Defaults to 1000,
after everything built in.

relationship.description: For a `relationship_kind`: how the line is drawn (API v2).

workload_kind.description:
For a `collector` whose command reads a table: present its rows as
workloads of a kind named by `title` (API v2).

PackApp.description:
An application a pack names for a server's Apps list. It always listens
on the server's own localhost: there is no host field, and InfraWerf
opens it through the same loopback-only tunnel as any other application.

path.description:
The page to open first, starting with `/`; 512 characters at most.
Defaults to `/`. Never a scheme or a host.

port.description: The port on the server's localhost, 1 to 65535.

PackBadge.description: Which pack observation a server badge shows.

observation.description:
The `id` of a contribution in this manifest whose command reads one
value (a `line` or `json` extractor) and has no parameters.

PackCommand.description:
One read-only command a pack contribution runs, and how its output is
read (plugin API v2). It is an argument vector, never a shell string.

argv.description:
The program, then its arguments: 1 to 16 entries. An entry holds
only letters, digits and `_ . , : / = + @ % -`, or is exactly
`{name}` for a declared parameter. The program is a plain name or an
absolute path and is never a shell, an interpreter or `sudo`.

healthy.description:
For a health check: the values that mean healthy, 1 to 8. Any other
value means unhealthy; no readable value means unknown. Required at
`health_check`, not allowed at `collector`.

parameters.description:
Values filled in from what InfraWerf discovered on the server, at
most 4. Each must be used by `argv`.

PackParameter.description:
A value InfraWerf fills in. The owner picks it from what an authenticated
session discovered; a pack cannot supply it.

name.description:
Lower-case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter,
32 characters at most. Written in `argv` as `{name}`.

PackRelationship.description: How a relationship of this kind is drawn. It is decoration only.

color.description: Defaults to `green`, the colour of a plain relationship.

PackWorkloadKind.description: Which columns of a collector's table name a workload and give its state.

name_column.description: The column that holds each workload's name.

state_column.description: The column that holds its state, if the table has one.

ParameterSource.description: Where a parameter's value comes from.

oneOf.description: The name of a systemd service found in the server's inventory.
The name of a container found in the server's inventory.

Separator.description: What separates the columns of a table.

oneOf.description: Any run of spaces or tabs.
One tab character.
One comma.
